levels.title: Filter with BETWEEN for Dates
levels.task: One department wants to analyze trends from 2023. Find all songs that were released anytime during the year 2023.
levels.solution: SELECT * FROM top_songs WHERE release_date BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-12-31';
levels.hintMessage: Use BETWEEN to capture a range between two dates.
levels.successMessage: Right on target! You've isolated the 2023 hits.

levels.title: Using LIKE with Wildcards
levels.task: Marketing is creating a visual playlist around the color pink. Find any songs with "pink" in the title.
levels.solution: SELECT track_name FROM top_songs WHERE track_name LIKE '%PINK%';
levels.hintMessage: Use `WHERE track_name LIKE '%pink%'` (SQLite’s `LIKE` ignores case for ASCII letters here).
levels.successMessage: You got it! Pink-themed playlist coming right up.

levels.title: Albums Starting with f
levels.task: To prepare for the month of February, the design team is making a f-themed music magazine. Help them find all albums that start with the letter f.
levels.solution: SELECT * FROM top_songs WHERE album_name LIKE 'F%';
levels.hintMessage: Use `LIKE 'F%'` (or `LIKE 'f%'`) so only names starting with F match; `%` is the wildcard for “anything after.”
levels.successMessage: Done! You’ve filtered albums for the design feature.

levels.title: Songs Released in May 2024
levels.task: To celebrate the start of spring, a seasonal campaign needs all songs released in May 2024. Help the team by finding them by using a wildcard.
levels.solution: SELECT * FROM top_songs WHERE release_date LIKE '2024-05-%';
levels.hintMessage: Use LIKE with a date pattern like '2024-05-%'.
levels.successMessage: Perfect! The May playlist is ready to go.

levels.title: Select with IN
levels.task: You’re building a comparison between Taylor Swift, Beyoncé, and Kendrick Lamar. Pull all their songs from the table.
levels.solution: SELECT * FROM top_songs WHERE artist IN ('Taylor Swift', 'Beyoncé', 'Kendrick Lamar');
levels.hintMessage: Use IN to filter for multiple values in one column.
levels.successMessage: Excellent! You’ve got every chart entry for those three artists in one place.
